name: lesson
voice: the prompt lesson — three layers, each with one job. Spoken two-tier stacks sit in the clear space beside the speaker's face (small setup words above, the payoff at 2.5× below, condensed heavy italic caps, white with a soft shadow, no outline); the setup holds still and the payoff lands on its word with a four-frame skew and motion blur; only the lesson words go lime. A chapter card answers the save ask (giant italic numeral, title, a bookmark that fills lime on "save"), and each technique gets a lower third: lime number, the name in an expanded black face, and a prompt box where the prompt types on with a caret, the last keystroke timed to a cut.
when: educational and tip-listicle ads cut from several shots (interview sets, demo inserts): "N things", prompt lessons, how-to explainers where the quotable line must hold on screen. Built for multi-shot edits — every stack is placed per shot from the matte, every exit snaps to the cut.
